neighbours.label: the copula or 'actually' just before an enthusiastic verdict in an informal first-person review ("this thing is amazing", "it's actually a super nice ...")
fire: Picked up this skillet on sale and honestly the thing is fantastic!! So happy with it.
I didn't expect much for the price but this jacket is actually super warm and comfy.
Finally tried the taco truck everyone talks about and it was unreal, so tasty.
My new keyboard arrived today and wow, this thing is gorgeous!!! Love the feel.
I thought it would be flimsy but the stand is actually a really solid piece of kit.
We stayed at that little inn last weekend and it was wonderful, just perfect.
Just unboxed the speaker and the bass is insane!! Totally recommend it.
Was worried about the size but the backpack is actually a great fit for my laptop.

notes: Card flags the pole broad. Probes: review verdicts 0.33-0.46 ('is awesome', 'actually a really nice', 'was amazing'); neutral copulas 0.01-0.03, 'is sharp' 0.14, a negative verdict ('is garbage') 0.10. Other top examples (pre-assigned tasks, highly critical, requirements) are not covered.
